cover: The cover of GPU-Accelerated Kubernetes: a raccoon in a dark cape stands at the rail of a ship at night, under storm clouds and a full moon, with harbour lights behind.
intro: Bundle, a white stork, stands on a wooden dock at dusk. Behind it a container ship loaded with stacked containers waits under cargo cranes.
ch01: Ledger, a great horned owl, sits on an open ledger at a library desk at night, under a warm desk lamp.
ch01-1: Rivet, a beaver in a yellow hard hat, works at a bench in a workshop, fitting a part that glows green.
ch02: A honeybee hovers beside honeycomb whose cells glow green, like the cells of a chip.
ch03: Doc, a basset hound in a white doctor's coat, stands in an aisle of a dark data center lit by status lights.
ch04: Sergeant Cone, a raccoon in a police cap and a reflective vest, directs traffic on a wet street at night, with police cars and traffic lights behind.
ch05: Badge, a red fox in a security uniform, stands guard at a gated checkpoint at night.
ch06: Shellby, a hermit crab, crawls across the sand at sunset between shells, with the sea behind.
ch07: 6 macaws sit side by side on 1 branch in a rainforest, each next to its neighbours.
ch08: Flock, a border collie, sits in front of a flock of sheep by a fence on a hillside at sunset.
ch09: 4 red squirrels sit side by side on a mossy branch in a forest.
ch10: Hash, a magpie, perches on a wooden cabinet of small drawers and jars in a dim room.
ch11: Chroma, a chameleon, stands on a desk in a dark room beside 2 glowing screens.
appendix: Kindle, a hedgehog, sits on a workbench beside a small computer and its screen, under a green lamp.
